doz.translation: n. 一打, 许多, 十二个

vt. 打瞌睡度过

dozen.definition:
n the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one
s denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
dozen.translation:
n. 打, 十二个
a. 一打的

dozens.definition:
n a large number or amount
n the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one

dozenth.translation: a. 第十二的, 第十二个的

dozers.translation: n. 推土机（dozer的复数）；打盹儿者

doziest.translation: a. 想睡的( dozy的最高级 ); 令人困倦的; 愚笨的; 迟钝的

doziness.definition:
n. The state of being dozy; drowsiness; inclination to
